result.title: SenseAlign: Learning Decision-Aligned Predictive Representations for Active Urban Sensing with UAVs
result.summary: Active urban sensing orchestrates a mobile sensor fleet to proactively inspect a dynamic road network and gather critical information for system management. This problem simultaneously requires understanding the complex spatio-temporal evolution and making decisions with partial observations. In this work, we focus on active sensing in a large-scale urban road network with utilities grounded in dynamic traffic states, while prior work has rarely considered these factors jointly. We propose \emph{SenseAlign}, a Reinforcement Learning-based (RL) framework that learns decision-aligned predictive representations for coordinating an urban sensing drone fleet. SenseAlign first trains a privileged teacher agent that exploits future ground-truth traffic for optimal sensing choices. The student agent has an auxiliary branch that learns to predict future traffic with partial observations, in addition to the RL-trained actor and critic branches. During student learning, our framework matches the action distributions of the teacher under ground-truth and student-predicted future traffic, while keeping the teacher's observations unchanged. Such a design shapes the latent space for decision-making instead of prediction alone. At inference time, the student agent has no overhead as all this learning is done in training. We conduct comprehensive experiments with the real road network of central Barcelona containing 1570 road segments, and demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms the baselines on multiple utility formulations. The codebase will be made publicly available upon paper acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SenseAlign，用强化学习协调无人机车队在巴塞罗那路网上做主动感知：先训练可利用未来真实交通的特权教师，再让学生在部分观测下借助辅助分支预测未来交通，并将师生在真实与预测未来下的动作分布对齐，从而塑造面向决策的 latent 表征。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预测未来状态 + 与决策分布对齐」的 latent 训练方式以及主动选择观测点的设定，可能为 LVR 中预测工作区、视觉证据筛选与「看哪里」决策的监督提供可核查线索；但任务属城市交通感知，迁移性需进一步判断。
